reach: public entry measured — the console record edit form of the seeded PAID invoice INV-1003 on a stock showcase boot (console built at objectui `4016370a`): line cells declared `readonlyWhen: parent.status == 'paid'` come up editable in 8 of 9 fresh loads (two independent runners), and an edit reaches the server.

Filed on behalf of the QA runner session `session_01NvpZQ6sRwAVRNDi4UsF2c7` (its GitHub scope did not include this repository) by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`.

## What is wrong
On a freshly loaded record edit form, the master-detail line grid evaluates its parent-scoped field rules against an EMPTY parent record whenever the header finishes loading after ~800 ms, so `readonlyWhen: parent.status == 'paid'` never locks the cells. A live status flip in the same form does lock them — only the initial load is lost.

## Reproduction
1. Stock showcase boot; sign in as admin through the form.
2. In a fresh browser context open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice/record/ID/edit` for INV-1003 (seeded `status: paid`; id from `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice?filter=[["name","=","INV-1003"]]`). Do not touch the header.
3. After the page settles (sampled at 3 s and ~10 s), read the first Line Items row: product lookup button, Qty, Unit Price.
   - Expected (objectstack-ai/objectstack `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts`, the line fields' `readonlyWhen`): disabled, as after a live flip to Paid.
   - Actual: enabled in 8 of 9 fresh loads (header Status shows "Paid", the header's own Tax Rate lock works). Typing 7 in Qty and saving sends `POST /api/v1/batch … {"object":"showcase_invoice_line","action":"update","data":{"quantity":7,"amount":349.93}}`.
4. Discriminator: on an unlocked load, dispatching a no-op bubbling `change` event on the status select locks Qty at once — the scrape works, only its timing is wrong.

## Mechanism (objectui `4016370a`, `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`)
- `MasterDetailLines`' `parentRecord` state starts `{}`; it is read once at mount, on form-host `input`/`change` listeners, and on timers `[120, 360, 800]`; the comment beside them notes the header loads asynchronously and fires no events.
- The effect re-runs only when `formHostRef` / `formKey` / `entries.length` change, so a header reset after the last tick is never read; the grids receive `contextRecord={parentRecord}`.

Expected fix shape: derive the parent context from the form's own record state (or re-read on the header's load/reset), not from a timer-bounded DOM scrape.

## Server consequence (context; separate owner, not this card's fix)
The server drops the locked `quantity` (`droppedFields … reason: readonly_when`) but stores the client-computed `amount`, so the line reads qty 6 / amount 349.93 and the paid invoice's rolled-up `total` changes. Not an authorization bypass (a business-state lock; the writer holds edit rights) — extracted on the framework side as objectstack-ai/objectstack#24619 row (a).
